description: A robust optimisation approach of train timetabling for freight transportation using high-speed railway is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Shengdong Li, Ming Zhu. To ensure reliable services for high-speed freight rail transport, we address the issue of robust freight train timetabling by incorporating buffer times. Unlike passenger trains with prescribed timetables, high-speed freight train timetables need to be scheduled from the beginning and integrated into existing passenger schedules. Coverage: the Chengdu-Chongqing high-speed railway, China. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3419687 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only.
